query: Читай CSV-файлы из директории /data/input/orders/, оставляй только строки где поле status равно COMPLETED, пиши результат в /data/output/completed_orders.csv.

runs.yaml_pim:
flow:
  id: csv_orders_filter_flow
  name: Filter Completed Orders CSV
  description: Read CSV files from input directory, filter rows where status is COMPLETED,
    and write to output CSV.
triggers:
- id: trigger_schedule
  type: schedule
  condition: every 1 hour
sources:
- id: source_csv_input
  name: Read Input CSV
  type: CSV
  location: /data/input/orders/
processing_elements:
- id: process_filter_status
  name: Filter Completed Orders
  operation: Filter
  config:
    condition: status == 'COMPLETED'
sinks:
- id: sink_csv_output
  name: Write Output CSV
  type: CSV
  location: /data/output/completed_orders.csv
processed_data:
- id: orders_csv_data
  format: csv
links:
- from_id: source_csv_input
  to_id: process_filter_status
  data_ref: orders_csv_data
- from_id: process_filter_status
  to_id: sink_csv_output
  data_ref: orders_csv_data
